name: Scrollbar
summary: A box that scrolls, with a scrollbar drawn in the mood's own colours instead of the platform's. The bar is a shape and a line, not a widget: there is no thumb to drag with a mouse, only a box that scrolls.
summaryZh: 一个能滚动的盒子,滚动条用这套 mood 自己的颜色画出来,而不是平台的默认样式。这条滚动条是一个形状加一条线,不是一个控件:没有可以用鼠标拖的滑块,只有一个会滚动的盒子。

variants.name: Solid
variants.note: The track is painted, so the bar sits in a channel of its own. The base class on its own is this run, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Ghost
variants.note: The track is not painted: only the thumb is, so the content is not framed by a box. The thumb still comes forward on hover.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A wide bar, for a box that is read by touch as much as by eye.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the scrolling box, inside the frame: an outside ring would be cut off by the frame that holds it.

parts.name: Wrap
parts.note: The element that actually scrolls. It carries the overflow and the scrollbar itself; the frame around it never scrolls.

parts.name: View
parts.note: The content inside the wrap. It is the caller's own markup, and the component adds no surface to it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Whether the track is painted. The solid run is the base class on its own; the ghost run adds um-scrollbar--ghost.
props.descriptionZh: 轨道画不画底色。实底是只写基础类;透明底再加上 um-scrollbar--ghost。

props.name: height
props.description: How tall the scrolling box is. The library cannot guess it: a box that is not given a height never scrolls, because its content is what gives it one.
props.descriptionZh: 滚动区有多高。库猜不出来:没给高度的盒子不会滚,因为给它高度的是它自己的内容。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The content that scrolls. It goes into the view.
slots.descriptionZh: 会滚动的内容。它放进内容区。

a11y.notes: The scrolling box is a real element with overflow on it and a tabindex, so it can be reached with Tab and scrolled with the arrow keys, the page keys and Home and End — the browser's own scrolling, not a script. The scrollbar the browser draws on top of that is replaced by the ::-webkit-scrollbar rules and by scrollbar-color, and neither of those adds anything to the accessibility tree: what a reader hears is the scrollable region and its content, which is the browser's announcement and not the component's. The thumb carries no text, because the position it shows is a picture of a position the browser already knows.
a11y.notesZh: 滚动区是一个带 overflow、带 tabindex 的真元素,所以 Tab 能走到它,方向键、翻页键和 Home、End 都能滚它 —— 这是浏览器自己的滚动,不是脚本画的。盖在上面的那条滚动条被 ::-webkit-scrollbar 规则和 scrollbar-color 换掉了,而这两样都不会往无障碍树里加东西:读屏听到的是可滚动区域和它的内容,那是浏览器的播报,不是这个组件的。滑块自己不带文字,因为它画出来的那个位置是浏览器早就知道的位置的画像。

examples.title: Solid track
examples.description: A list in a box that is shorter than the list. The track is painted, so the bar sits in a channel of its own. The box is given a height, because a box that is not given one never scrolls.
examples.descriptionZh: 一列东西放在一个比它矮的盒子里。轨道画了底色,所以滚动条待在自己的一道槽里。盒子给了高度,因为没给高度的盒子是不会滚的。

notes: The frame paints the line and clips the corners; it paints no surface, because a fill here would put the scrollbar's own track on top of a second layer of the same translucent colour, and the colour under the bar would then be one that no role names. The scrollbar is drawn twice over, once for the WebKit engines with ::-webkit-scrollbar and once for Firefox with scrollbar-color, because the two engines do not share a way of painting it. The thickness is a component constant rather than a mood's spacing step: a scrollbar that is 28 pixels wide because the theme's section gap is 28 pixels is not a scrollbar.
notesZh: 外框只画那道线并把圆角切掉,不画表面:这里要是填了底色,滚动条自己的轨道就叠在第二层同样半透明的底色上,条子底下那个颜色就成了谁都没命名的颜色。滚动条画了两遍,一遍给 WebKit 的引擎用 ::-webkit-scrollbar,一遍给 Firefox 用 scrollbar-color,因为这两家没有共用的一种画法。粗细是组件自己的常量,不是主题的间距刻度:因为章节间距是 28 像素就把滚动条画成 28 像素宽的,那不是滚动条。
